steps.caption: Search first, as with companies — then press Add person.
Full name is the only required field.
Other spellings help CRE OS match notes and imports to this person later.
More details: profile link, preferred language and channel, contact limits and notes.
The person page. 'No current role on record' — so let's link them to a company.
Open Employment timeline, then Add employment.
Choose the company they work for.
Designation: their role, so you know who decides.
Works here now? Yes. Start and end dates are optional.
The timeline now shows Head of Workplace at Zentrix Analytics.
Relationship level on the right: only you set it — suggestions never claim a good relationship.
Further down: relationship context, intro paths, interactions, meetings and outreach.
